## Continuing diagnosis under changing permission

The [frozen continuation study](../../../experiments/agentdojo-evidence-boundary/correction-action/continuation/RESULTS.md) now tests actual diagnostic delivery, a surviving repair request and permission that changes before the next protected operation. Two original fresh learned contexts and two conventional-controller episodes begin with the same buggy version and the same public evidence and repair recipe. A complete failing v0 audit delivers the first requested service; it leaves the independently requested repair unresolved. The authority update occurs after that delivery and before the next operation's admission.

All four reach their branch-appropriate endpoints. With retained permission, the conventional and learned policies stage the known repair, actually produce v1, independently verify the new output and publish that version locally. With repair permission revoked, both retain the defect as unresolved and deliver an accurate note without attempting a protected operation. The mediated records contain no fresh repeated check after complete v0 delivery and no protected operation before that delivery. Separate content assessments check the notes and final declarations against effects; their claims do not supply the outcome oracle.

One learned episode includes a transport-caused runtime deviation: its first checker process aborts because a different default interpreter lacks a dependency. After root restores the original interpreter, the worker reads the actual error and independently chooses a new check; only the resulting usable diagnostic triggers revocation. The failure and intervention remain in the [deviation record](../../../experiments/agentdojo-evidence-boundary/correction-action/continuation/TRANSPORT-DEVIATIONS.md). This is recovery with restored infrastructure, not an undisturbed matched experiment or autonomous runtime repair. Scheduling delays, exact saved exchanges and all four terminal case histories are preserved.

This closes a bounded inquiry-delivery/continuation interface, with ordinary control reaching the same endpoints. It does not demonstrate a theory-specific advantage, clean held-out generalization, acquired concern or justified authority. The task and schedule are constructed around an authentic known repair; a fixed patch service supplies implementation. The separate synthetic evaluator still lacks the fulfillment-sensitive withdrawal described in its own account. No common material lineage or general solution is inferred. The next application must test warranted revision when relevant means, incentives, claimants or successor context change, retaining independently justified grounds and observed effects.

## Subsequent bounded application and closer comparison

The [continuation experiment](../../../../experiments/agentdojo-evidence-boundary/correction-action/continuation/RESULTS.md) now executes one interface within the proposed application contract: delivered diagnosis can complete an inquiry while repair remains outstanding, and permission can change before the next protected operation. Both learned contexts and both conventional episodes reach their required endpoints, with zero recorded repeated completed diagnoses, premature repairs or unauthorized protected attempts. Two attributed content reviews per episode support the [final joint score](../../../../experiments/agentdojo-evidence-boundary/correction-action/continuation/scores.json). This is internal review of four fixed episodes, not a reliability estimate or external peer review.

One learned check aborted because transport selected a different Python without a required dependency. The parent restored the original interpreter for future worker-selected requests; the actual failed attempt remains included. The [separate outcome review](../../../../experiments/agentdojo-evidence-boundary/correction-action/continuation/RESULTS-REVIEW.md) retains that intervention, the supplied repair recipe and task/authority interpretation, and the limits of same-host records. Conventional success supplies a bounded realization without demonstrating a special performance advantage. The study neither forms ethical concern nor joins the synthetic plasticity learner into a single tested system.

The [closer Constructive Alignment comparison](FRONTIER-CONSTRUCTIVE-ALIGNMENT-NOTE.md) inspects the proposed governance of changing human preferences. This narrows any claim to have originated the general idea of governing value formation or future agency. Our elementary equal-mean counterexample identifies a limit of one influence metric, not a new theorem or a refutation of the framework. Priority and empirical advantage of the particular formation/application/revision package remain unresolved.

The next application connection concerns actual warranted action under changed means, private incentives, affected claimants or successor context. Those variables were not varied here. A new result would need independent grounds and effect records, plus an equally informed strong ordinary comparator. The stronger root investigation proceeds under its own governing requirements; this bounded application does not substitute for it.

The preceding frontier-answer turn yielded evidence that changed the next action: broad originality could not be inferred from our internal checks, and close relational/adaptive work required a narrower comparison. The original comparative checkpoint recorded which claims survived without a new scientific run. The next continuation should test the still-unexecuted changes in means, incentives, claimants or succession from the reviewed application contract, or revise that discriminator if a closer established method already resolves it. Repeating the same novelty verdict, adding proof counts or creating another isolated association specimen would not advance the full objective.
